messages:
Maya: Weekend poll — thinking of spending Sunday morning doing a tiny rooftop microgarden refresh (repot succulents + labels) or heading out for a short harbor brunch + paddle? which do you all prefer? :seedling: :canoe:
Jon: microgarden sounds zen. I'm in for plant wrangling.
Priya: Brunch + paddle if the wind is calm. Also can bring bagels.
Sam: Either works. If plants, I can bring potting soil. If boat, I have a 2-person kayak.
Alex: Microgarden for me — my hands need dirt therapy. what time?
Maya: thinking 10am for plants on the roof garden; 11:30am meet at the pier for boat. quick vote: :white_check_mark: plants, :boat: paddle
Jon: :white_check_mark:
Priya: :boat: (leaning paddle)
Sam: :white_check_mark:
Alex: :white_check_mark:
Priya: PS if paddle, where to park? nearest is Harbor St. free spots by the ferry.
Maya: good call — let's do plants if more checkmarks. final call from @Priya since she has the kayak? :grin:
Priya: I can bring the kayak, but only if someone brings bagels. deal? :bagel:
Jon: deal. I'll bring sesame bagels.
Sam: I'll bring soil and a small trowel.
Alex: I'll bring extra pots and plant labels.
DevBot: Reminder — rooftop garden access code changed to 3821.
Maya: thanks DevBot. also FYI — weather app says 60% chance of fog at 9am but clears by 11.
Priya: sounds like plants it is. See y'all 10am on the roof. :seedling::sparkles:
Sam: woohoo.
Jon: see you there!
Alex: can't wait :)
